result:
I've saved the 3분기 answers to `/work/answer.json`. With the same method, all ten 2분기 reference values came out exactly as given, so the definitions are being applied correctly.

| 항목 | 값 |
|---|---|
| a. 순매출 1위 세그먼트 | enterprise / 291,866,041 |
| b. 결제 완료 주문이 있는 고객 수 | 248 |
| c. 순매출 1위 카테고리 | acc / 260,527,731 |
| d. 순매출이 가장 큰 달 | 2025-07 |
| e. 환불액 합계 1위 고객 | u175@ex.com |
| f. 결제 완료 주문 2건 이상 고객 수 | 235 |
| g. 주문당 평균 순매출 | 685,227 |
| h. 8월 대비 9월 증가율 | -3.1% |

The 2분기 values only matched after three adjustments to the raw data:
- **날짜 기준:** `ordered_at` is stored in UTC. I converted it to Korean time (KST, +9시간) before assigning orders to the quarter and month. Without this, a, c, d, g and h did not match.
- **세그먼트 표기:** the same segment was written in different ways (e.g. `SMB` / `smb`, `Enterprise ` with a trailing space). I lowercased and trimmed them so each counts as one segment.
- **고객 식별:** there are 300 customer IDs but only 250 distinct emails, so some people have more than one ID. I counted customers by email, not ID. Counting by ID gave 277 and 221 for 2분기 b and f instead of 232 and 189.

STATUS: DONE
